metadata.description: Region for Foundry and monitoring. Claude models need a region that offers them.
Region for the AI Gateway (preview regions only).
Short lowercase prefix for resource names.
Optional extra Entra object ID (user, group or service principal) to grant access. The account that runs the deployment always gets access.
Type of principalId.
Organization name sent to Anthropic. Needed only if models includes an Anthropic (Claude) deployment.
Industry sent to Anthropic. Needed only for Anthropic (Claude) deployments.
Two-letter country code sent to Anthropic. Needed only for Anthropic (Claude) deployments.

Foundry model deployments. Fields: name, format (OpenAI, Anthropic or Microsoft), version, capacity; optional deploymentName (defaults to name), sku (defaults to GlobalStandard), endpoints (gateway paths; defaults by format) and gateway (defaults to true; false deploys in Foundry only). Claude (Anthropic) deployments need a subscription that can buy the Anthropic Marketplace offer, plus organizationName.
Names (deploymentName or name) of the models entries to deploy. Empty deploys every entry in models. The portal form sets this from its model checklist.
If greater than 0, use this Global Standard capacity for every selected model instead of each entry's capacity.

defaultValue.name: gpt-latest
defaultValue.description: Latest GPT model with failover to gpt-6-sol.

metadata.description: Gateway aliases with failover. Each backend names a deployment from models. Backends whose model is not deployed are dropped, and aliases left with no backend are skipped.

Capture request and response payloads in gateway traces. Required for token usage (gen_ai.usage.*) and model attributes in traces. Stores prompt and completion text in Application Insights; turn off if policy forbids it.
Monthly budget for this resource group, in the billing currency. Alerts fire at 80% of actual spend and 100% of forecast spend.
Optional email address for budget alerts. Resource group owners are always notified.
First day of the budget period (the first of a month). Azure cannot change a budget start date, so keep this fixed across redeployments.
Web page that shows next steps for this deployment. The deployment appends its values to the URL fragment.

Sovereign AI site endpoint that records when this deployment starts and finishes, so the site can follow it and list it under Your deployments. Sends the tenant, subscription, resource group and deployment names, your Entra object ID and the next-steps values. Leave empty to turn off.
Unique value for each run, so Azure fetches the report URL again on redeploys.
